notes:
Summary: Accountspring is a mid-market billing platform focused on subscription analytics and support. Primary need: replace siloed chatbot with a payments-aware support agent that can call Stripe/Zuora APIs, return structured JSON for downstream processing, and stream partial answers to the agent UI. They emphasize strict latency SLOs (95th percentile < 250ms for streaming tokens, sub-100ms prefix response for tool-calling handoff where possible).

Recent conversations: AE (Aarav) demoed Hosted API streaming + function-calls. SE (Jordan) did a follow-up deep-dive on tool-calling patterns, JSON schema enforcement, and validation hooks. Customer asked for example receipts as JSON, webhook flow for disputes, and a fallback plan to a cheaper model during load spikes.

Technical constraints / preferences: currently using Stripe + Zuora for billing; integrations must support idempotent tool calls, signed webhooks, and strict audit trails. Data residency: primary US, some EU customers require EU residency. SOC2 in scope; they want KMS or HSM for keys.

Business context: mid-market support org ~45 agents handling subscription churn and disputes. Volume estimate: peak 25–40 concurrent agent sessions, estimated 8000 conversational messages/day; latency and streaming UX are high priority to reduce handle time. Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics and SLOs are proven.

Quotes / call snippets: "We need the agent to hand us a clean JSON that our workflow can consume — no free-text parsing afterwards." — Head of Support.

POC ask: 2-week POC on Hosted API with streaming + tool-calls to a sandbox Stripe connector; success criteria include: 1) structured JSON outputs validated by their webhook consumer, 2) 95th pct latency under 250ms for non-tool tokens, 3) reliable function-calls with at-least-once/at-most-once semantics documented.

Next steps noted: send Dedicated pricing sheet for reserved capacity, share recommended batching/quantization profile from Redwood Optimize for receipts workload, schedule security kickoff for SOC2 evidence.
